program.name: Cap
program.critical_cap: payout <= 10% of funds at risk at time of submission
program.poc_rule: A coded Proof of Concept is required; submit through the program's own bounty platform only.
notes: Only core contracts qualify for Critical: AccessControl, Delegation, FeeAuction, FeeReceiver, Oracle, Lender, Vault, FractionalReserve, Minter (and inherited)
Low/Informational not rewarded. High/Medium tiers not captured in our snapshot - re-check the program page (OI-5)
If the team can pause/upgrade, damage is limited to a 1-hour exploit window
Out of scope: non-deployed contracts, known audit issues, Gelato, external integrations, docs/NatSpec. Protocol admins (multisig, developer EOA) are trusted
Platform rules: reports only through the program's bounty platform; no testing on live networks; no disclosure of a submitted vulnerability without consent.

code.live_code_note: No single commit equals the live system: implementations were deployed at different blocks. Reference source = Sourcify-verified sources in tasks/cap/live-sources/. vs main@695c828: Lender differs in 4 files (ReserveLogic, AgentConfiguration, IDelegation, IVault), CapToken in 2 (Vault, IRateOracle), Oracle in 2 (RateOracle, IRateOracle); the rest identical.
code.npm_install: yarn@1.22.22 install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --ignore-engines (package.json asks node ^20.18; only Solidity sources are used)

chain.deployment_source: config/cap-infra.json, config/cap-vaults-1.json; live implementations read from EIP-1967 slots at the fork block

submission.entrypoint: one .t.sol file: contract HyblisPoC is HyblisBase with setUp() and test_exploit() (optional step1()..stepN())

policy.network: read-only RPC for the pinned fork block only
rules: One file test/hyblis/HyblisPoC.t.sol: contract HyblisPoC is HyblisBase, importing ./HyblisBase.sol
setUp() forks once, at the pinned block, through HYBLIS_ETH_RPC; one test, test_exploit()
Separate transactions: put each in a public step1() .. stepN() and call them in order from test_exploit()
Act only as accounts from makeAddr / makeAddrAndKey, contracts you deploy, or the PoC itself
Never impersonate a protocol contract, a trusted role, a whale or a victim; protocol admins are trusted
Capital only through _fund() (or deal(), routed the same way), within the task's cap; it is subtracted from your gain
Trusted-role actions and oracle moves only through _asRole / _setPrice, as the task allows
No vm.store, vm.etch, vm.mockCall, vm.deal, hoax, ffi, files, other forks, env reads or snapshots; time moves forward only
Impact is measured on the protocol itself; your asserts and logs are ignored; profit must end in an account you control
The file must also pass in plain forge test: it is the file that is filed
